name: Metalcraft Email
description: Persona, skill, and HTTP API tools to READ a user's email via Metalcraft Email (email.metalcraftai.com), a read-only IMAP mailbox cache. List connected mailboxes (memail_accounts), list recent messages with account/unread/date filters (memail_list), full-text search subject/sender/body (memail_search), read one message with its recipients, body, and attachment references (memail_get), and read a whole conversation (memail_thread). Read-only: this pack cannot send, delete, or modify mail. Authenticated by a single Metalcraft account token — METALCRAFT_TOKEN, sent as Authorization: Bearer — the same token that works across every Metalcraft ecosystem app. The API base is fixed to https://email.metalcraftai.com.
